context: On the day of the competition
purpose: Race day; teach 競技/スキル/マシン/エリア/必死/武器/神経/競馬

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 競技、いよいよ本番だね。
lines.style: excited friend pumped up, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 練習で身につけたスキルを、出すだけ。
lines.en: I just bring out the skills I trained.
lines.style: composed athlete focusing, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あのマシン、調子よさそう。
lines.style: friend reading the equipment, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ウォームアップエリアで、もう体は温まった。
lines.en: In the warm-up area, my body’s already warm.
lines.style: athlete ready to go, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 必死さが顔に出てるよ。
lines.en: Your fierce focus shows on your face.
lines.style: friend observing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スピードが俺の武器だ。
lines.style: athlete affirming himself, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 神経を切らさず、最後まで！
lines.en: Don’t break your nerve to the finish!
lines.style: friend cheering hard, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 競馬みたいに、ゴール一直線で行く。
lines.en: Like horse racing, I’ll dash straight to the goal.
lines.style: athlete with vivid resolve, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
